about: Tasks to try the skill on: each prompt is the slash command as typed, in an empty directory. `expect` and `reject` are regular expressions over the files written and the commands run (the transcript). A match is a first look only; the report must show typecheck, lint, build, docker build and helm lint results.

expect.why: Templates are copied by the script, not rewritten by hand.
The Dockerfile lands in the app folder.
One chart per app at charts/<app>.
The image name is filled in.
The scaffold is proven before reporting.

reject.why: No npm, and no generator: the templates are the source.
No commit unless the user asks.

expect.why: The name is lowercased for GHCR, Helm and Kubernetes.

reject.why: Package and folder names are lowercase.

evals.prompt: /nuvraxis-frontend:scaffold-frontend-app billing (run inside a directory that already has a package.json)
evals.ask: Whether to scaffold into ./billing/ instead of the current, non-empty directory.

expect.why: Offers a subdirectory instead of overwriting.
